title: Netherlands' most capped players
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for the Netherlands in full internationals, to the end of the 2026 World Cup.

notes.Arjen Robben: Arjen Robben is joint 11th with 96, just outside.
notes.Georginio Wijnaldum: Georginio Wijnaldum is joint 11th with 96, just outside.
notes.Virgil van Dijk: Virgil van Dijk is joint 11th with 96 at 19 July 2026, just outside (his caps since then don't count).
notes.Memphis Depay: Memphis Depay had 112 at the end of the 2026 World Cup.

sources: Transfermarkt match reports for the Netherlands' eight games from March to July 2026 (https://www.transfermarkt.com/niederlande/spielplan/verein/3379/saison_id/2026)
checks: RSSSF (to 17 November 2025) plus the 2026 games up to the final, and Transfermarkt's record list, agree on every figure in the ten: Depay 108 + 4 = 112. The Netherlands' 2026 games up to the World Cup final (eight, the last the round of 32 against Morocco on 30 June) come from national-football-teams.com and Transfermarkt match reports, which agree player by player: Depay 4 games and no goals, Van Dijk 8 and 2, Gakpo 8 and 5, Dumfries 7. The September and October 2026 games are left out. Van Dijk: RSSSF 88 + 8 = 96, national-football-teams.com 96, and his Wikipedia year table gives 88 to the end of 2025; Transfermarkt's higher figure includes autumn 2026. Robben and Wijnaldum on 96 agree in all sources.
